summary: community.aws inspector_target is deprecated because Amazon Inspector Classic reached end of life on May 20, 2026, and will be removed in 12.0.0.
questions: When did Amazon Inspector Classic reach end of life?

answer_card.title: inspector_target deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `community.aws.inspector_target` is deprecated because Amazon retired **Amazon Inspector Classic** on **May 20, 2026**, revoking console and API access. The module will be removed in version 12.0.0.
